newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.20 rupee up in the kerb at 42.76 to the dollar on Thursday amid dull trading because of a liquidity crunch that forced players to stay on the sidelines, dealers said.

"The dollar will rise sharply as the demand is there but players have gone short of rupees to buy dollars," dealer Owais Kalia of Khanani & Kalia International said. The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 6.80 percent, compared to its previous close of 7.0 percent.-- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
